name: Security Scan Hero
description: Centered dark product hero: a spinning shield brand mark, a mono delivery badge, an oversized heading with an inline brand tile, dual CTAs, three auto-advancing feature tabs with filling progress tracks, and an animated app window where a brand scan line sweeps a mock app over a node grid, flagging a security warning.
interactions: app scan line sweeps the window: translateY(-213px) -> 400px at 0% / 70-100%, 5s ease-out infinite (verbatim keyframe wpmn-ssh-scan)
brand mark ring orbits 14s linear infinite (two dots on a rotating ring)

feature tabs auto-advance every 4000ms once the section reaches 20% viewport; active tab brightens and its progress track fills 0->100% over 4s (inset transition); clicking a tab jumps to it and restarts the timer
stage fades up on first view, 700ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)
primary CTA enable/hovered/pressed at 120ms; dark CTA hover lifts fill 8%->12%
prefers-reduced-motion: spin and scan off (scan parked mid-window), no auto-advance, stage shown in place
